raw_text: Deepfake Video of Indian Army Chief Traced to Pakistani Origin, Says Intelligence. A deepfake video depicting the Indian Army Chief making provocative statements about Pakistan was fabricated using face-swap technology and circulated from accounts traced to Pakistani IP ranges, India Today has confirmed through intelligence sources. The video was initially amplified by Pakistani media before forensic analysis revealed lip-sync artifacts and DIRE analysis confirmed digital manipulation.
clean_text: India Today confirms deepfake Army Chief video traced to Pakistani IP ranges using face-swap technology. Initially amplified by Pakistani media before forensic debunking revealed lip-sync artifacts and DIRE manipulation.
